contentAccounts.title: Accounts
contentAccounts.description: Publishing accounts for this brand, and the persona prompt each one writes with.
contentAccounts.empty: No accounts yet. Create one to set its platform and persona prompt.
contentAccounts.displayNamePlaceholder: How you tell this account apart
contentAccounts.personaDescription: What this account writes like. Leaving it empty is fine — it stays pending until you fill it in.
contentAccounts.personaPlaceholder: Describe the voice, the audience, what to avoid
contentAccounts.conflict: Someone else saved this account at the same time — save once more

expressionProfile.sectionDescription: How this account speaks, who it speaks to, and how much time there is each week. Any item may stay pending — pending is not an error.
expressionProfile.readFailed: Could not read this account's profile
expressionProfile.readFailedHint: The read failed, so what is stored is unknown — this is not an empty profile. Retry before changing anything.
expressionProfile.neutralOnHint: There is no confirmed style sample, so this account writes in a neutral voice and says so on the draft. It does not stop material being recorded or written by hand.
expressionProfile.neutralOff: Writes from the confirmed style samples
expressionProfile.extractUnavailable: Not available yet (executors disabled, arriving with EP-08)

placeholders.common_questions: The questions they ask again and again
placeholders.experience: What you have done that earns this subject
placeholders.positioning: What this account is, in one sentence
placeholders.content_pillars: The few directions you write around
placeholders.expression_style: Tone, sentence shape, how you give examples
placeholders.forbidden_expressions: Wording, overstatement and promises to avoid
placeholders.content_goals: What these posts are meant to achieve
placeholders.style_samples: Paste passages you wrote yourself, one per line

contentTopics.title: Topics
contentTopics.description: Manually written topic cards for this brand, and the frozen briefs their work starts from.
contentTopics.empty: No topic cards yet. Write one below to record who it is for and what it decides.
contentTopics.createDescription: Seven items, from docs/01 §5.2. Writing “none” is a complete answer — leaving a box empty is not.
contentTopics.firstRevision: The version this card started with

fields.audienceProblemJudgment: Who it is for, the problem, the judgement

placeholders.audienceProblemJudgment: Who reads it, what it solves, what it claims
placeholders.ipFit: Why this IP is the one to say it — or that it is not a fit
placeholders.timing: The timing basis, or “no timing basis”
placeholders.existingContentRelation: What it follows on from, or “no existing work”
placeholders.evidenceGapsAndInvestment: What evidence is missing and what it will take
placeholders.recommendedAction: Start, save, defer or drop — and why

contentTopics.decisionDescription: Start creates the first frozen brief. Starting again keeps the same first version.
contentTopics.decisionReasonHint: Kept for defer and drop; a start or a save does not store it.
contentTopics.decisionNotePlaceholder: Anything the reason does not say
contentTopics.briefDescription: Versions are appended, never edited. Open one to read what it said.
contentTopics.briefReadOnly: Read-only — a change is saved as a new version.
contentTopics.appendDescription: Eleven items, from docs/01 §5.3. Saving appends a version and leaves the older ones as they are.
contentTopics.appendHint: Available once something differs from the latest version.

unavailable.title: Not available yet
unavailable.description: Later cards in this series. Named here so “not built” does not read as “broken”.

contentTopics.accountHint: Optional. A card written for one account can say why it fits that account.
contentTopics.accountDescription: Which account this card is written for. Changing it is recorded.
contentTopics.filterByAccountHint: Narrow the list to one account, or to the cards with none.

start.title: Start a run
start.description: Fix the configuration this piece of work begins from. What is fixed here does not change afterwards.
start.accountHint: The account this card is written for. Change it in Account above.
start.accountMissing: This card is not linked to an account yet. Link one above before starting.
start.readinessNoAccount: Choose an account first — readiness is judged per account.
start.readinessFix: Confirm the missing items on the account page, then come back.
start.readinessUnknown: Could not read the account's readiness.
start.revisionHint: Any existing version can be started, not only the newest.
start.scopeHint: Starts from the account's saved preference ({{preference}}). Changing it here applies to this run.
start.projectHint: Optional. Left empty is a real state, not a missing value.
start.precheckOff: Off — turning it off does not remove human review
start.neutralHint: Recorded, not a gate: it explains later why a piece reads neutral.
start.notIdempotent: Starting again produces a second run with its own snapshot.
start.blockedAccount: Link an account to this card first.
start.blockedReadiness: The account is missing some of the minimum conditions.
start.pendingDescription: These are recorded empty, and each one says which card will bring it. Nothing here is invented.

reasons.material: Material selection arrives with a later card.
reasons.files: File input arrives with a later card.
reasons.grants: Grants are decided but not stored anywhere yet.

start.historyDescription: {{count}} so far. Each start fixed its own snapshot.
start.historyEmpty: This version has not been started yet.
start.snapshotDescription: Read-only and permanent. Later edits to the account, the preference, the brief or the brand switch do not reach it.
start.extensionKey: topic-planning's own key, not one of the aligned sixteen
start.scopeDiffers: This run used a scope other than the account's saved preference

contentWorks.sectionDescription: What has been produced from this topic card. No model is needed — writing, editing and keeping versions all work without one.
contentWorks.empty: No works yet. Create one to start writing.
contentWorks.documentsEmpty: No documents yet. Add a body or a channel cut.
contentWorks.bodyPlaceholder: Write here. It saves on its own when you pause — and autosaving does not create a version.

draftStatus.working: Changes not saved as a version

contentWorks.autosaveFailed: Autosave failed; your text is still in the editor
contentWorks.historyEmpty: No versions yet. Save one when a passage is ready.
contentWorks.restoreHint: Restoring adds a new version. No older version changes.
contentWorks.compareHint: Two full texts side by side. Word-level differences are not part of this phase.
contentWorks.compareNone: There is nothing to compare a single version with.
contentWorks.aiUnavailable: Not available yet (executors disabled, arriving with EP-08)
contentWorks.conflict: Someone saved a version at the same moment; save again

contentReviews.sectionDescription: Ask someone to look at one specific version for one specific channel. What is approved is that combination — a later version needs its own review.

blocked.notAChannelDraft: Only a channel cut can be submitted: a review is of a specific channel's version.
blocked.noVersion: Save a version first. A review freezes one, and there is none yet.
blocked.noAccount: Choose the account this is going out on.

contentReviews.historyHint: One row per submission. Submitting the same document again is normal and makes a second request.
contentReviews.historyEmpty: Nothing has been submitted for review yet.
contentReviews.snapshotHint: Read-only. This is the combination that was submitted; changing the document afterwards does not change it.

snapshot.noStart: This work was not started from a snapshot.
snapshot.attachmentsPending: Attachments arrive with W-03; none can be attached yet.

contentReviews.decisionHint: Write what you saw, then choose. A decision cannot be changed afterwards.
contentReviews.decisionClosed: This request has been decided. Submit a new one to review a newer version.
contentReviews.notePlaceholder: What should change, or why this is fine
contentReviews.approveAndScheduleHint: One click, {{steps}} records: the approval and the delivery task are saved separately.
contentReviews.aiUnavailable: Not available yet (executors disabled, arriving with EP-08)

contentDeliveries.sectionDescription: A to-do for getting an approved piece out. The system never sends anything itself.
contentDeliveries.scheduledAtExplainer: This is a time for you to read. Nothing happens at it — the system has no scheduler and will not publish anything on its own.
contentDeliveries.handoffNotPublished: Exporting, copying and handing it to someone else are not publishing. Record the publication separately once you know what happened.
contentDeliveries.reasonHint: Holding, cancelling, a failure or a postponement all need a reason written down.
contentDeliveries.heldTitle: On hold: the approved version is no longer the one being delivered
contentDeliveries.heldHint: Either have the new combination reviewed, or deliberately keep delivering the approved one (request {{reviewId}}).

contentPublications.sectionDescription: What a person saw on the platform. The system does not check, and does not guess.
contentPublications.pendingRegistrationHint: It was handed over and nobody has written down what happened. The system will not go and look.
contentPublications.formHint: Say what you saw and how you know. Which fields are needed depends on what you choose.
contentPublications.pageUrlPlaceholder: https://… or the platform's content id
contentPublications.verificationHint: Free text — write what you actually did.
contentPublications.receiptHint: A screenshot description, a colleague's word, or the reason it failed.
contentPublications.declaredByHint: Free text. Often not the person typing this in.
contentPublications.declaredByPlaceholder: A colleague on the operations side
contentPublications.platformAccountPlaceholder: The account it went out on
contentPublications.editNoteHint: Leave empty if it went out as written. The reviewed version is never rewritten.
contentPublications.versionMatchHint: Unknown is a real answer: use it when the full text could not be retrieved. It is not a failure.
contentPublications.historyHint: Newest first. The current state is the newest row; older rows are never changed or removed.

contentMetrics.sectionDescription: Numbers a person read off a platform and typed in. The system never goes and looks, and stores no platform credentials.
contentMetrics.noRecordsHint: Numbers hang on a publication record. Record what happened above first.
contentMetrics.recordHint: A piece published, removed and published again has several. A number belongs to exactly one of them.
contentMetrics.listHint: Newest first. Reads and plays are kept apart and never added together — different platforms do not measure the same thing.
contentMetrics.formHint: One observation: what you looked at, over what window, when. Corrections are a new row — nothing here is edited or deleted.
contentMetrics.accountPlaceholder: The account it went out on
contentMetrics.metricHint: Eleven names, the ones the SOP gives. There is no "other".
contentMetrics.valueHint: Leave it blank if the platform does not show it. Blank means unknown; 0 means you looked and it is zero. They are not the same thing.
contentMetrics.windowHint: Free text — "14 days after publishing" cannot be written as a start and an end.
contentMetrics.evidenceHint: Free text. Attachments arrive with W-03 — there is nowhere to put a file yet.
contentMetrics.evidencePlaceholder: Screenshot of the backend, taken the same day
contentMetrics.submitHint: Adds a row. It cannot be edited or deleted afterwards.
contentMetrics.csvHint: Copy the cells out of a spreadsheet and drop them in. All or nothing: one bad row stops the whole paste.
contentMetrics.csvNoUpload: No file upload yet — that arrives with W-03.
contentMetrics.csvColumnsHint: platform, account_id, metric, value, unit, stat_window, sampled_at. A header line may reorder them.
contentMetrics.csvUnknownCount: {{unknown}} of them carry no number, and will be saved as unknown — not as 0.
contentMetrics.csvAllOrNothing: Nothing is imported until every row is usable.
contentMetrics.csvSubmitHint: Every row lands, or none does.

problems.outsideTheSet: not one of the allowed values

contentFeedback.formHint: The quote and what you make of it go in two fields. Joining them loses which half is evidence.
contentFeedback.redactYourself: Redact it yourself before pasting. Nothing here removes names, handles or numbers for you.
contentFeedback.excerptPlaceholder: Finished it and went straight to buy
contentFeedback.interpretationHint: Your own reading. Kept apart from the quote on purpose.
contentFeedback.interpretationPlaceholder: The comparison in the third paragraph is doing the work
contentFeedback.occurredAtHint: When they said it, not when you are typing it. RFC 3339.
contentFeedback.submitHint: Either field alone is fine. A row with neither records nothing.
contentFeedback.listHint: Newest first. Nothing here is counted, grouped, scored or read for sentiment.
contentFeedback.aiUnavailable: Unavailable for now (executors are off; arrives with EP-08). Nothing below is a generated conclusion.
contentFeedback.pendingHint: Published, and nobody has recorded a single number for it. Not "overdue" — there is no observation time to be past.
contentFeedback.pendingScope: Everything under this brand, not only this piece.
contentFeedback.pendingElsewhere: On another piece — open that document to record it.

contentToday.title: Today
contentToday.description: What is worth writing, what is in progress, what needs a decision, and what is due.
contentToday.deepLinkHint: Opens the topics page: reviews and handovers live under a card's work and document, and have no route of their own.

topics.title: Topics worth writing
topics.unavailableHint: Automatic candidate generation is unavailable (EP-04c has not landed). These are the draft cards people created.

deliveries.title: Handovers due and publications to record

feedback.title: Feedback to record
feedback.derivation: Published, and nobody has recorded a single number for it.

contentSources.title: Material inbox
contentSources.description: Collect what is worth keeping, then organise it. Nothing here is fetched or parsed for you.
contentSources.parseUnavailable: Material parsing is unavailable for now (it arrives with the parser). Everything below was typed by a person — no summaries, entities or related material are generated.
contentSources.urlNotFetched: The link is stored, not opened. Write down what it says in the note below.
contentSources.historicalHint: Material brought in from before, rather than collected just now. Set when it is collected and never changes.

problem.url: A link starting with http:// or https://

contentSources.duplicateHint: The same text is already here as {{count}} other items. All are kept, each with its own note.
contentSources.originalReadOnly: Stored as collected. It never changes.
contentSources.noOriginal: A link has no stored text — what it says is in the note.
contentSources.noDelete: There is no delete. Archiving keeps it and takes it out of the list.
